original_idea.body: # Eval-Awareness Cue Ablation Harness. A harness that ablates tell-tale cues in Petri/Apollo scenarios and ranks which surface features shift the awareness signal. Pure prompting + API.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Reusable harness for sanitizing evals maps clearly to safety-eval validity.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Prompting harness + ablation; accessible to beginners, no training.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused tool but builds a harness + ranks multiple cues; modest scope.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Eval-builder infrastructure with public scenarios; independent-friendly.

novelty.reasoning: Eval-awareness probes exist; a systematic cue-ablation harness plausibly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: No systematic cue-ablation tool reported; angle plausibly open.
